Lyrics and any API key go to your custom LibreTranslate-compatible server. Server privacy, quotas and charges apply. Prefer HTTPS: HTTP exposes both lyrics and credentials. Enter a base URL or /translate URL.
Lyrics go to api-free.deepl.com. Use your own DeepL API Free key, not a translator subscription. Your account quota applies. No bundled key.
Lyrics go to api.deepl.com. Use your own DeepL API Pro key. Paid API usage is billed to your account. No bundled key.
Lyrics go to Google Cloud. Enable Cloud Translation API and billing in your own project, restrict the key to this API and set quotas. Usage may incur charges. No bundled key.
Enter a valid HTTP(S) URL for custom servers, or your API key for Google/DeepL, and valid language codes.

Use provider-supported language codes, e.g. auto → en, zh or ja. DeepL also supports target variants such as EN-US. Online mode replaces source translations. Changing service clears the API key; backups never include it.
